ModMetaData.name: No Overeating
ModMetaData.author: Riketta
ModMetaData.description:
Pawns and animals no longer eat a piece of food when that last piece would overflow their stomach and the extra nutrition would be wasted.
An adult ibex at 0.06/0.32 food with rice (0.05 nutrition per grain) available eats 5 grains, not 6 - vanilla takes the 6th and throws away the part that does not fit. When every available food overflows anyway (say, a simple meal at 0.9 nutrition), the pawn still eats one unit: overeating is acceptable when it is unavoidable.
All amounts are read from the actual food, the eater and its current food need at runtime - no hardcoded foods, races or nutrition values. Works with DLC and modded food, for humans and animals alike, on maps and in caravans.
Safe to add and remove at any time - nothing is saved to the game state.
Source code & details: https://github.com/Riketta/NoOvereating
